title: The Aggregate — LLM benchmark aggregate
description: Fused LLM rankings: one IRT/Elo scale across ~5,000 public benchmark leaderboards, updated daily.
summary: Fused LLM rankings: one IRT/Elo scale across ~5,000 public benchmark leaderboards, updated daily.
offersHint: Fused LLM rankings: one IRT/Elo scale across ~5,000 public benchmark leaderboards, updated daily. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://theaggregate.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_leaderboard
toolsPreview.description: Top of the cross-benchmark aggregate ranking: every model placed on one Elo scale by an IRT model fit over ~5,000 public benchmark leaderboards. Supports paging via limit/offset.

toolsPreview.name: search_models
toolsPreview.description: Find ranked models by (partial) name or provider. Returns rank, Elo and the model page URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_model
toolsPreview.description: One model in depth: aggregate rank, Elo with standard error, provider, what it is, cost per task where known, and its most notable benchmark results (with percentiles).

toolsPreview.name: compare_models
toolsPreview.description: Head-to-head between 2-4 models: aggregate ranks, Elo gap with a significance note based on the standard errors, and notable benchmarks they share.

toolsPreview.name: search_benchmarks
toolsPreview.description: Find benchmarks in the aggregate by (partial) name. Returns model coverage, difficulty on the Elo scale, and the benchmark page URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_benchmark
toolsPreview.description: One benchmark in depth: what it measures, the original source leaderboard URL, IRT stats (difficulty, noise, model coverage), skill weights, and the current top models on it.

toolsPreview.name: get_prediction_duel
toolsPreview.description: Guesswork — the public prediction duel: every day frontier LLMs and The Aggregate's own IRT model predict newly scraped benchmark scores before seeing them, and the errors are scored. Returns the current monthly standings, wins and losses included.

toolsPreview.name: about_the_aggregate
toolsPreview.description: What this data is: how the IRT fusion works, current coverage counts, update cadence, and how to cite it.
